name: The Lust City 2
source: Embark on an exotic quest in "The Lust City 2"! Lead your crew through a steamy jungle, unlocking treasures and secrets of an ancient tribe. Craft your seductive harem in a thrilling adventure that will leave you breathless.
translation: 在《欲望之城2》中踏上异国任务！带领你的船员穿过潮湿的丛林，解开古老部落的宝藏和秘密。在一场惊心动魄的冒险中打造你诱人的后宫，让你喘不过气来。
